issues.where: the foreground and midground cliff face
issues.what: the rock is built from large flat polygonal facets with sharp angular edges and stretched, repetitive textures that read immediately as a low-poly CG mesh
issues.fix: replace with high-resolution sculpted or scanned rock geometry using micro-displacement and varied non-repeating rock materials

issues.where: the close-up rock faces (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42% and y 58 to 75%) and the tattered veil (x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the rock shows a visible rectangular tile-like grid and blurry stretched UVs across flat faces, while the veil shows polygonal facets, pixelated cutout edges, and rainbow moire banding
issues.fix: remove tiled grid seams with high-resolution seamless triplanar rock maps, and replace the ribbon mesh with volumetric simulation or high-subdivision cloth with physically based translucency

issues.where: the dark grey cliff face (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) and the veil tether (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the rock surface breaks down into a blocky pixelated texel grid with sharp polygon strips clipping through it, and the tether bends in a rigid angular kink into a banded translucent sheet
issues.fix: increase texture and displacement resolution to eliminate pixel blocking, blend intersecting rock layers cleanly, and smooth the tether geometry and shading

issues.where: the prone animal in the foreground and midground
issues.what: the fur reads as stiff, jagged polygon hair cards with patchy painted snow, the body sinks into the foreground ice ridge with no weight displacement or contact shadow, and a hard black seam cuts across its left shoulder
issues.fix: use dense groomed strand fur with natural clumping and snow accumulation, sculpt snow compression and soft contact shadows beneath the body, and close the shoulder seam

issues.where: the animal torso and fur (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) and the dark water/ice surface (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the fur breaks into aliased flat alpha-cutout cards over a glossy torso with concentric UV banding, while the dark liquid patch is horizontally smeared noise with a dead-straight flat edge, no wet margin, and no reflections
issues.fix: replace alpha-card fur with true strand grooming and seamless organic skin shading, and render a physically reflective water/slush surface with a wet frozen crust edge

issues.where: the lightning bolt, the sky ribbons streaming from the peak, and the left horizon
issues.what: the lightning is a uniform bright line that lights none of the nearby clouds, spires, or snow, the pale wisps read as flat CG ribbon meshes, and the left background drops into a flat grey tint with no atmospheric depth
issues.fix: add bounce illumination and atmospheric bloom from the lightning onto surrounding clouds and peaks, replace the ribbons with volumetric spindrift, and add layered distance haze and sea/cloud structure on the left

issues.where: the snow boulders left of the animal (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%) and the background sky and cliffs (top panels and bottom-left)
issues.what: the snow-covered rocks are low-poly faceted hemispheres with smooth clay-like shading, the rock face shows blurry stippled artifacts, and the upper-left sky is horizontally smeared
issues.fix: subdivide and displace the rocks with natural fractured silhouettes, sharpen the cliff textures, and use native-resolution sky clouds

issues.where: below the dark rock overhang (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) and the distant spires and cloud sea (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: a large smooth untextured white polygon smear stretches diagonally beneath the overhang with a fuzzy seam at the snow-rock join, and the distant cloud sea reads as smooth blurry noise around repeated low-poly horn spires
issues.fix: repair the stretched UV and geometry beneath the overhang with crisp snow-rock contact detail, vary the distant spire silhouettes, and render volumetric clouds with internal light scatter

issues.where: the dark clusters on the cables (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the bulbous growths have pure-black unlit shadows, plastic-like specular spots, and rigid smooth cables piercing through them with uniform cone-shaped icicles
issues.fix: lift shadow values with sky ambient bounce light, vary surface roughness to remove the plastic sheen, and add organic irregularity to the strands and ice formations

issues.where: the vertical cliff wall behind the animal's right flank and the foreground ice ledge
issues.what: the sheer cliff wall shows heavy vertical UV stretching (also visible in set-A-01.png) and the foreground ice ridge has smeared low-resolution texture
issues.fix: apply triplanar rock projection to the sheer cliff wall and increase surface detail on the foreground ice ledge

issues.where: the storm clouds (top-left, top-right, bottom-left) and left horizon (bottom-right)
issues.what: at native 4K crop size the storm clouds are soft, low-resolution painted blobs and the left horizon is a featureless flat grey tint
issues.fix: replace with high-resolution volumetric clouds or sharp sky plates and add atmospheric gradation and sea/cloud detail toward the horizon
